_note: Phase 4 re-baseline (2026-09-13), deliberate. Two full runs on a box shared with the lidar pipeline agent (load average 21 during the first, 57 during the second); each metric here is the better of the two runs, which is the less-contended estimate, and the second run's fps/lidar figures are absent because that pass timed out under the load. Re-run on a quiet machine before believing any single failure.
_imagery: The VBMP orthoimagery basemap is now on by default, and it is the reason firstTileMs and mapIdleMs are up against Phase 3 (863 / 1265 ms): the first raster tile and map idle now wait on 256 px JPEGs fetched from vginmaps.vdem.virginia.gov through the dev proxy, over the public internet, rather than on a local PMTiles range request. transferBytes is up 1.41 MB for the same reason. Production serves these from our own origin as PMTiles (web/README.md), which is where this comes back down.
_fps: fpsZ15 is with imagery on (the default), fpsZ15NoImagery the same path with it off - 1.4 vs 1.3, i.e. the raster basemap is not what costs under swiftshader. All fps figures are software GL and informational, not gated.
_lidar: heapBytesLidarZ17 is downtown Fairfax City (-77.3064, 38.8462) at z17 pitch 55 with the point cloud on: 240,000 points over two chunks, 18.5 MB heap against 13.2 MB with it off. Measured against the SYNTHETIC fixture (pnpm fixture:lidar), 120k points/chunk at 16 bytes/point - the pipeline's real chunks had not landed when this was recorded, so re-baseline once they have.
_reach: reachNodes 4193 (was 2333): the reach data changed under us this phase, not the isochrone code.
